issues.title: Add POC and CSR Fields to Organization Records
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** ORBIT Admin,
* **I want to** add and manage a "ORBIT POC" and a "CSR" for each customer organization record,
* **so that** I can maintain up-to-date points of contact for both organizational and technical support, ensuring better communication and service.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

**Scenario 1: Adding / editing the Organization Record Form**

* **Given** I am on the Admin Settings page for creating or editing an organization's record,
* **When** the form is displayed,
* **Then** I **must** see two data fields labeled "ORBIT POC" and "CSR".
* **And** the "ORBIT POC" field **must** use employee lookup from the Organization
* **And** the "CSR" field **must** use employee lookup from ORBIT as a whole.
* **When** I attempt to save the record 
* **Then** the organization record **must** save successfully.

**Scenario 2: Viewing the Organization Data**

* **Given** data has been successfully saved in the "ORBIT POC" and "CSR" fields for an organization,
* **When** I view the details of that organization's record (in a read-only view),
* **Then** the saved values for both new fields **must** be correctly displayed.

issues.title: Notify Organization Managers of New Registrations
issues.description:
**Description:** This PBI implements an automated email notification to Organization Managers when a new user registers for their organization *without* selecting a specific Suborganization (Layer).

---

#### **User Story**

*   **As an** Organization Manager,
*   **I want to** receive an immediate email notification when a new user registers for my organization without selecting a specific PM/Layer,
*   **so that** I can take timely action to approve their account and ensure they are properly assigned within my organization.

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

*   **Given** a new user is registering and selects an "Organization" but leaves the "Suborganization (Layer)" field blank,
*   **And** there are one or more users assigned the "Organization Manager" role for that Organization,
*   **When** the user successfully submits their registration,
*   **Then** an email notification **must** be sent **only** to the Organization Managers of the selected Organization.
*   **And** the notification **must not** be sent to any Layer Managers.
*   **And** the email subject line **must** clearly indicate its purpose (e.g., "New Unassigned User Registration for [Organization Name]").
*   **And** the email body **must** contain the new user's name and a link to their Employee page.

issues.title: Align Download with Filter Selection - Position Assignments page
issues.description:
**Description:** This PBI corrects the behavior of the download option on the "Position Assignments" page to ensure the exported file respects the user's currently selected filter (Active, Inactive, or All).

---

#### **User Story**

*   **As a** user on the "Position Assignments" page,
*   **I want** the download option to export only the records that match my selected filter,
*   **so that** I can easily generate a targeted report of the data I am currently viewing without having to manually filter a larger file.

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

**Scenario 1: "Active" Filter is Selected**

*   **Given** I am on the "Position Assignments" page,
*   **And** I have selected the "Active" filter, displaying only active records,
*   **When** I click the "Download" button,
*   **Then** the downloaded file **must** contain only the "Active" position assignment records.

**Scenario 2: "Inactive" Filter is Selected**

*   **Given** I am on the "Position Assignments" page,
*   **And** I have selected the "Inactive" filter, displaying only inactive records,
*   **When** I click the "Download" button,
*   **Then** the downloaded file **must** contain only the "Inactive" position assignment records.

**Scenario 3: "All" Filter is Selected (Regression Check)**

*   **Given** I am on the "Position Assignments" page,
*   **And** I have selected the "All" filter, displaying all records,
*   **When** I click the "Download" button,
*   **Then** the downloaded file **must** contain all position assignment records (both Active and Inactive).

_INC0032565_

issues.title: Notify Layer Managers of New Registrations
issues.description:
**Description:** This PBI implements an automated email notification to Layer Managers when a new user registers and selects their specific PM (Layer) as Suborganization.

---

#### **User Story**

*   **As a** Layer Manager,
*   **I want to** receive an immediate email notification when a new user registers and has selected my PM/Layer as Suborganization,
*   **so that** I am immediately aware of new employee in my specific area of responsibility and can take appropriate action.

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

*   **Given** a new user is registering and selects both an "Organization" and a specific "Suborganization (Layer)",
*   **And** there are one or more users assigned the "Layer Manager" role for that specific Layer,
*   **When** the user successfully completes their registration,
*   **Then** an email notification **must** be sent **only** to the Layer Managers of the selected Layer.
*   **And** the email notification **must not** be sent to the Organization Managers.
*   **And** the email subject line **must** clearly indicate its purpose (e.g., "New User Registration for Layer: [PM/Layer Name]").
*   **And** the email body **must** contain the new user's name and a link to their Employee page.

issues.title: Alignment of data fields on Settings page
issues.description:
* **As an** Organization Manager or ORBIT admin,
* **I want** the data presented in the left column of the settings page to be vertically aligned with the corresponding label,
* **so that** I can more easily match the data with the lable when viewing the page. 

**Acceptance Criteria**

* **Given** an Organization Manager or ORBIT Admin is viewing the Settings page for an organization,
* **Then** the data fields **must** be vertically aligned with the corresponding label for that data field.
